executive_summary: Strategic scope charter for LE LEVAIN, an artisanal bakery flagship in Portland, Oregon. The digital experience centers on driving recurring sourdough subscription memberships, real-time daily bake board transparency, and local pickup pre-orders while preserving heritage culinary integrity.

value_pillars.strategic_rationale: Positions LE LEVAIN above industrial retail bakeries by highlighting wild Portland microflora starters, regional heritage grain varietals, and uncompromising 36-hour slow fermentation practices.
Drives immediate daily foot traffic and web engagement through an operational live-state bake schedule displaying oven release times, batch numbers, and stock status.
Secures predictable recurring revenue and customer retention via custom weekly and bi-weekly sourdough share configurations with self-serve pickup scheduling.
Reinforces Portland food-culture affinity through direct farmer mill partnerships, seasonal rotating crumb profiles, and educational sourdough maintenance stewardship.

target_personas.title: The Discerning Culinary Enthusiast
pain_points: Frustrated by mediocre grocery store bread masquerading as sourdough with commercial yeast additives
Disappointed by arriving at premier bakeries only to find signature boules already sold out
Wants reliable origin tracing of stone-ground regional grains and hydration levels
jobs_to_be_done: Check daily bake status and exact fresh-from-the-oven batch timing before travelling to the bakery
Secure guaranteed weekly rations of naturally leavened country sourdough through a subscription tier
Discover grain profiles and fermentation details for each rotating specialty bake

target_personas.title: The Neighborhood Daily Regular & Commuter
pain_points: Short morning pickup window before commuting or school runs
Long physical lines causing unexpected delays during peak morning hours
Lacks visibility into which morning pastry or loaf batches have emerged from the hearth
jobs_to_be_done: Rapidly view the current morning oven roster in under 15 seconds
Reserve daily loaves or viennoiserie for same-day quick-pickup lockers/counter
Manage subscription pause/resume settings when traveling or out of town

target_personas.title: The Conscious Host & Gifting Member
pain_points: Needs exceptional centerpiece loaves and seasonal bakery baskets for dinner gatherings
Unclear allergen or grain composition details for dining guests
Inconvenient ordering processes for specialty weekend bakes
jobs_to_be_done: Schedule advanced bundle orders for weekend gatherings with allergen breakdown clarity
Gift curated sourdough club memberships to fellow Portland food lovers
Receive transparent notifications when limited seasonal loaves go live on the bake board

in_scope_features: Interactive Daily Bake Schedule displaying batch release times, loaf types, hydration/grain details, and live availability indicators (Fresh from Oven, Limited, Sold Out)
Bread Club Sourdough Subscription Configurator with customizable cadence (weekly, bi-weekly), loaf tier selection (Country Blonde, Heritage Spelt, Seeded Rye), and pickup time-slot allocation
Bakery Heritage & Provenance Narrative section documenting 36-hour wild-fermentation craft, Oregon mill partnerships, and starter lineage
Same-Day Pickup Reservation Flow allowing guests to claim fresh batches with real-time inventory countdown
Digital Bakery Counter FAQ covering storage, bread revival guide, slicing recommendations, and dietary/allergen specifications
Location, Hours, and Real-Time Hearth Status indicator (Oven Firing, Baking, Warm on Shelves, Closed for Prep)
out_of_scope_features: Nationwide or cross-state cold-chain shipping logistics
On-demand third-party delivery driver fleet dispatch (e.g. DoorDash, UberEats integrations)
B2B wholesale bakery invoicing and merchant distributor ordering portal
In-person Point of Sale (POS) hardware terminal management or kitchen printer integrations
Interactive sourdough starter home-baking mobile app or IoT thermometer sync
success_metrics: Subscription conversion rate >= 4.2% among unique visitors landing on the Bread Club page
Bake Schedule bounce rate < 35%, with average time-on-page >= 1m 45s demonstrating strong utility
Pre-order pickup claim rate reaching > 85% of allocated daily digital stock before 10:00 AM PST
Subscriber retention rate exceeding 88% month-over-month on active recurring loaf memberships
strategic_assumptions: LE LEVAIN operates out of a single flagship retail bakery and hearth production space in Portland, Oregon with on-site customer pickup.
Bake schedule updates can be updated daily by bakery floor leads via a lightweight status interface or scheduled recurring bake cycle model.
Initial digital commerce capability focuses on customer pick-up allocation and recurring credit card billing without native long-distance shipping overhead.
Customer base prioritizes transparency in agricultural sourcing, organic whole grains, and sourdough health benefits over mass discounting.
